question: Which GST thin film in the Sn-incorporated GST terahertz study had the highest conductivity at 1 THz, and what power was its Sn target sputtered at?
rendered:
According to the excerpt from page 7, the Sn-incorporated GST thin film with the highest conductivity at 1 THz was the Sn24W-GST film, which had a conductivity of 49.43 S/m at 250 °C. 

This film was deposited at a Sn target sputtering power of 24 W.
